hero.label: Made for Growth
hero.headline: I want to help Growth crack the retailer channel from day one.
hero.subheadline: Early-stage growth roles at startups targeting retailers are rare, and the timing here feels right. I have spent the last year doing exactly the unglamorous work that makes growth happen: cold outreach, pipeline building, and digital conversion testing. I want to bring that into a retail growth context where the playbook is still being written.

whyCompany.title: Retailers are a notoriously hard channel worth cracking right
whyCompany.body: Winning retailer relationships requires persistence, structured outreach, and the ability to speak a buyer's language quickly. That is not a generic sales problem, it is a sequencing and messaging problem. I find that challenge genuinely interesting, not just on paper.

whyCompany.title: Being early means the playbook is yours to build
whyCompany.body: An early-stage startup hiring for a growth function means there is no inherited process to maintain and no bureaucracy to clear. The person in this seat gets to figure out what works, document it, and scale it. That is the environment where I do my best work and learn the fastest.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and NextAfter reps map directly to this work
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach sequences in HubSpot and LinkedIn that helped acquire 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, so I know what it takes to move a cold contact to a signed deal. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy focused on digital conversion, which sharpened how I think about the full funnel beyond just the first touch. Both experiences point straight at what a Growth Retailers role needs.

quote: I am at the stage of my career where I want to be somewhere that does not have all the answers yet. Growth at the retailer level is a real puzzle and I want to be the person in the room helping solve it.
